evidenceRole: A frozen recomputation on the 76 consumed D9 development-plus-validation questions, followed only after independent validation and committed admission by one untouched read of the 30-question LongMemEval-V2 procedure test split.

exit.borrowedPrinciple: Use extractive evidence units, preserve their source order, and abstain when a complete safe compression is unavailable.
exit.scopeDifference: D11 uses deterministic accessibility-tree semantic values and exact certificates rather than a trained sentence classifier.

recomp.borrowedPrinciple: Keep compression above the retriever and expose a null augmentation action when the compressed context is not useful or safe.
recomp.scopeDifference: D11 does not train a compressor or use answer likelihood at runtime.

informationPreservation.borrowedPrinciple: Measure detail preservation and grounding beside token compression and downstream utility; entity and value loss is a first-class failure mode.

d10NegativeResult.finding: D10 reduced mean tokens by 33.55% and had a positive consumed point estimate, but one answer-bearing StaticText value was discarded by an anchor-only capsule.
d10NegativeResult.designResponse: Retain every bounded semantic value from the exact Base items being replaced; if the complete evidence, anchor, and action capsule does not fit, return exact Base.

consumedDesignDiagnostic.boundary: The two recorded renderings used consumed questions and selected the D11 representation only. Their scores cannot support confirmation.

split.testReadRule: No D11 test baseline, D10 comparator, candidate, or answer may be materialized before D11 passes the consumed audit, an independent validator reports zero mismatches, and a committed D11 admission artifact exists.

lockedConsumedBaselines.reuseRule: Recompute Base through the unchanged MemoryCore FTS5 path and require exact query, candidate ids, injected ids, tokens, and direct-support values before using a locked row.

lockedD10Comparator.reuseRule: For consumed audit, recompute the D10 selected procedure, replaced ids, safe anchors, context, tokens, support, and decisions for both arms and require exact agreement before scoring D11.

baseline.engine: MemoryCore SQLite L0 FTS5 through executeConversationSearch
baseline.queryTransform: Remove final-answer formatting instructions only; retain the substantive question and options.

candidate.selectionRule: First reproduce the exact D10 procedure decision. D11 may enrich only that selected same-trajectory capsule; evidence failure returns exact Base and cannot select an alternative procedure.
candidate.evidenceRule: Extract each meaningful primary accessible value from the exact Base items selected for replacement, deduplicate by support normalization, and render every retained value verbatim with source-memory provenance and original source order.
candidate.evidenceOverflowRule: Decline to exact Base; never truncate, rank, summarize, paraphrase, or answer-condition evidence.
candidate.actionCertificate: Every action line delivered by the reproduced D10 decision must occur in the D11 capsule.
candidate.anchorCertificate: Every D10 safe anchor must occur in the D11 capsule.
candidate.evidenceCertificate: Every bounded extracted semantic value and source provenance marker must occur in source order in the D11 capsule.
candidate.unrelatedCertificate: Every unrelated Base item remains byte-for-byte and in its original relative order.
candidate.costCertificate: The capsule token count cannot exceed the exact sum of removed Base-item tokens; total injected tokens and item count cannot exceed exact Base.
candidate.nullAction: Any ineligibility, overflow, certificate failure, ambiguity, or lack of locally verified actions returns exact Base.

localFeedback.source: The unchanged D10 bounded local-progress table and ranking rule.
localFeedback.verifiedArm: Reproduce D10 Wilson-ranked same-trajectory selection and deliver only locally verified bounded abstract actions.
localFeedback.agnosticAblation: Reproduce D10 FTS-ranked same-trajectory selection and deliver all bounded abstract actions; evidence extraction, certificates, format, and fallback are identical.
localFeedback.selfOptimizationClaimGate: Local feedback may be credited only if it changes contexts, is quality-noninferior with zero direct harms versus the agnostic arm, and reduces mean injected tokens versus that arm.
localFeedback.evolutionBoundary: Only the bounded step-feedback table, same-trajectory ranking, and verified action subset evolve. Semantic evidence is deterministic and all-or-nothing. FTS5, embeddings, raw indexing, questions, answers, and Base remain unchanged.

portability.adapter: SourceEvidenceAdapter extracts bounded provenance-bearing semantic spans from Base-selected items. The public UI adapter reads primary accessibility values; an internal programming adapter may expose exact test output, diagnostics, repository diffs, code/config spans, files, symbols, and constraints under the same all-or-nothing bounds.
portability.unchangedCore: Selection, same-trajectory ownership, evidence/action/anchor/unrelated/cost certificates, capacity limits, switches, logging, and fallback do not depend on the public schema.

forbiddenRuntimeInputs: development, validation, audit, or test phase labels

selfOptimization.candidateFreeze: The selected compact representation and every bound, certificate, gate, and comparator are frozen before the D11 audit score is recomputed.
selfOptimization.failureRule: A failed consumed audit rejects D11 without reading test. A failed untouched test rejects D11 without answer-level calls. Any follow-up must be a newly versioned direction.

directMetric.definition: Use the D9 lower-case, hyphen, punctuation, and whitespace-normalized phrase-set support metric. English action counts only match the explicit Observed source action count field; list markers never count.
directMetric.orderedSecondary: For ordered phrase questions, all normalized atoms must occur in order within one delivered memory unit.
directMetric.scopeWarning: This is representation-level support evidence, not task accuracy or gold evidence recall; answer-level evaluation remains a later gate.

aggregation.bootstrap: paired stratified question bootstrap by domain

answerLevelGate.claimBoundary: A direct-support pass only admits an answer experiment. Both requested providers must complete before any dual-reader conclusion is reported.
